title: Article: Unintentional Dark Arts of the Astral World

segments.text: How a Relative Becomes a Tantrik Without Knowing"
Let’s understand this with an example of an Ashaeiynn aspirant:
Imagine a mother who wants to control her son, an Ashaeiynn aspirant. She visits a priest for guidance, and he gives her a specific practice to follow.
The Unseen Effect of Energy
As the mother follows the priest’s instructions daily, she unknowingly activates the priest’s energy to help her.
Over time, her son starts experiencing negative effects.
When observed through Drishti, it is revealed that the priest’s energy is performing black magic daily on the aspirant—without the priest even realizing it.
Why No One is Guilty
When Bhaiya investigates astrally, he asks the priest why he is doing this. Surprisingly, the priest is unaware—his energy itself is acting.
The priest believes he has done nothing wrong.
The mother is also unaware that this is a form of black magic.
Since neither is intentionally harming the aspirant, no action can be taken against them.
How to Overcome This?

In such cases, the only solution for the aspirant is to increase his dimension. By crossing the priest’s dimension, the black magic stops affecting him, as lower-dimensional energies cannot overpower a higher-dimensional being.
The Key Lesson
Not all black magic is done with evil intent. Sometimes, people unknowingly activate energies that work against others. The only way to stay unaffected is to continuously upgrade one’s dimension!
How Ashaeiynn Guides You to Elevate and Expand Your Dimension?

In Ashaeiynn , an energized mantra plays a crucial role in helping aspirants upgrade their dimension . This initiated mantra is constantly energized, providing continuous support for spiritual growth.

Beyond the mantra , Ashaeiynn also helps its aspirants through homa (havan) , a powerful fire ritual. Every month, on the full moon day , a special havan called “Mahahawan” is performed without fail. This sacred practice further aids aspirants in elevating their dimension and strengthening their spiritual journey.
How Mahahawan Helps an Ashaeiynn Aspirant Increase Dimension Rapidly

In Ashaeiynn , the Mahahawan is a powerful tool for spiritual growth. When an aspirant enrolls in Jagriti Sankalp during this sacred havan, their dimension can increase by 50 to 500 levels in just one session.
The Power of the Initiated Mantra & Mahahawan

Apart from the havan, mantra chanting plays a crucial role in boosting an aspirant’s dimension. The initiated mantra , when chanted regularly, accumulates mantra shakti , which, when combined with Jagriti Sankalp , leads to exponential growth in dimension .
Let’s Understand This with an Example
Imagine an Ashaeiynn aspirant who chants the initiated mantra for 11 hours a day . According to Bhaiya , chanting for 11 hours in one day increases an aspirant’s dimension by 50 levels .
Day 1: 11 hours of chanting → Dimension increases by 50
Day 2: Another 11 hours → Mantra shakti accumulates to 22 hours → Dimension increases to 100
Day 3: 33 hours of mantra shakti → Dimension reaches 200
After 1000 hours of chanting , the aspirant’s dimension skyrockets to 5 crore!
Mahahawan Accelerates This Growth Even Further

Now, if this aspirant enrolls in Jagriti Sankalp and participates in Mahahawan , his dimension jumps from 50 to 500 in just one havan . With every subsequent havan, his dimension grows exponentially at an even faster rate.
Healing Through Mahahawan

Not only does this havan elevate dimensions , but it also helps those suffering from negativity, black magic, or ancestral issues (Pitra Dosh) . By participating in Mahahawan, they can free themselves from these problems in a short duration .
Thus, the combination of mantra chanting and Mahahawan creates a powerful pathway for rapid spiritual upliftment , allowing an aspirant to reach higher dimensions in a short span of time !
